{{Orphan|date=March 2018}}

In [[mathematics]], in the field of [[group theory]], a [[subgroup]] <math>H</math> of a [[group (mathematics)|group]] <math>G</math> is said to be '''weakly normal''' if whenever <math>H^g \leq N_G(H)</math>, we have <math>g \in N_G(H)</math>.

Every [[pronormal subgroup]] is weakly normal.
